name: sql_formatter
description: Browser-native SQL formatter and minifier. Format, minify, and validate SQL with configurable options (dialect, indent, keyword case, comma placement). All processing in WASM — no server upload.

tools.name: format_sql
tools.description: Format SQL with configurable options including dialect, indent size, keyword case, and comma placement.

indent_size.description: Number of spaces per indent level.

comma_before.description: Place commas before items (leading style) when true.

lines_between_statements.description: Number of blank lines between semicolon-separated statements.

max_line_width.description: Target maximum line width (reserved for future line-wrapping).

tools.name: minify_sql
tools.description: Compress SQL to a single line by removing unnecessary whitespace and comments.

tools.name: validate_sql
tools.description: Check SQL for syntax errors and warnings. Returns validity status and list of issues.

tools.name: list_sql_dialects
tools.description: Return the list of supported SQL dialects.
